about: What a HoltTest cell's key covers (contract 1.3, rulings R5, R14, R17). keys.py reads it: an entry (holt:GUEST[+VARIANT] is entries[GUEST]) merges over kinds[its kind], lists adding up; PLAT in a path is the entry's plat. A kind is the driver ht1.sh hands the guest to (ht1.sh:70-76); 'driver' names it and 'variants_run' the HT_VARIANT values it takes as Test2 cells (ht1.sh's fitting variants, smaller, fitbigger, nearfull and refuse, are HoltTest1's only). Variants have no inputs of their own: the cell name is in the key. Pins and family lists are classes.json's (holt.pins, holt.families). The floor is ht_manifest's list (ht1-lib.sh's manifest.txt): the driver, ht1-lib.sh, judge.py, fsmeta.py, vm-run, vm-mount, the rescuer image, bin/'s debs and bcachefs, bko-holt, rustic-bko and the guest's disks.
notes: harness: what runs the round trip or makes its records. ht1.sh is in every kind's: the queue runs ht1.sh GUEST RUN, which hands BSD, illumos, Haiku, Redox and Sculpt guests to ht1-bsd.sh or ht1-offline.sh (ht1.sh:70-76). compare/fsmeta.py records the files, so it is harness, not judge (R5 (d)).
judge: holttest1d/judge.py alone (it reads the dumps and fsmeta's records).

plumbing: the write path and the queue (ht1-lib.sh, ht1-queue.sh, ram-size.sh, ram-sizes.tsv), vm-run and the shared cmp-run.sh and iolog.sh: a change makes the four canaries due (classes.json holt.canaries), the rest canary-verified.

rescuer, Linux kinds: '@firmware' is rescuer-uefi.qcow2 for a UEFI source on a host that has it, else rescuer.qcow2 (ht1.sh:134-141, R17); bin/*.deb and bin/bcachefs are what ht1.sh copies into the share (ht1.sh:302-303). ht1-offline.sh always takes rescuer.qcow2 and no debs (ht1-offline.sh:56, 112-116).

rescuer, other systems: the live rescuer guest's generation (freebsd15-ufs, netbsd11, haiku6), or the one-time copy's image (ht1-bsd.sh:206-305), which follows no update of its guest until R1. The rescuer guest's vm-run-options (ht1-bsd.sh:174) isn't keyed.

per_guest: files a driver references that only some guests use, so they are in those guests' entries, not the kind's: the passphrase typers (ht1.sh:186-198, the first of console-passphrase, zfs-passphrase, luks-passphrase the guest has: ht1.sh:154), Redox's console and tools, Sculpt's screen check (sculpt-check.sh imports testvm/haiku/drive.py).

firmware: the guests whose vm-run-options have --uefi (both hosts, 2026-11-08); holt.run keeps a UEFI Linux source off a host without rescuer-uefi.qcow2 (R17). classes.json holt.uefi lists the Linux ones too.

per_guest.testvm/console-boot.py: guests whose first passphrase file is console-passphrase or zfs-passphrase
per_guest.testvm/omarchy/type-luks-passphrase.py: guests whose first passphrase file is luks-passphrase
per_guest.testvm/vanilla/console-keys.py: guests whose restored disk boots a second GRUB entry, picked on the serial menu (vm_up's GRUB_PICK: vanilla3's other root)
per_guest.testvm/holttest1d/nvboot-efivars.sh: the UEFI guests (firmware uefi, classes.json holt.uefi): ht1.sh inlines it in NVBOOT, which runs only with a GVARS store (ht1.sh: uefi and --no-secure-boot) and reads the booted entry from efivarfs where efibootmgr is missing (Guix System)

per_guest.testvm/redox/console.py: redox: its root login on the serial console

proxmox9-mirror.notes: two disks (vm-run-options --disk proxmox9-mirror-b.qcow2), an ESP on each: ht1.sh boots each restored disk alone too (boot_each_disk, rpool DEGRADED) and judge.py esp compares both ESPs (docs/design/proxmox.md P6)

vanilla3.notes: ABRoot's two roots: ht1.sh boots the restored disk twice, the other root picked on GRUB's serial menu by console-keys.py (vm_up's GRUB_PICK); D 30 is over every RAM-disk ceiling, so it runs only on /bkoscratch, on a host whose holt_disk_mode is on (docs/design/vanillaos.md V7)

pikaos4-luks.notes: LUKS2 root (Btrfs) in BOOTX64 mode: booster asks for the passphrase on ttyS0 and console-boot.py types vms/pikaos4-luks/console-passphrase (docs/design/pikaos.md P4)

freebsd15-geli.notes: GELI root pool; ht1-bsd.sh types vms/freebsd15-geli/console-passphrase at the loader through console-boot.py (docs/design/geli.md)

openbsd8.notes: its one-time rescuer is on Chopin only (classes.json holt.pins)

dragonfly6.notes: its one-time rescuer is on Cinqcent only (classes.json holt.pins)

redox.notes: its tools are on Cinqcent only (classes.json holt.pins)
